Preflight is green (edison: CONFIGURED, mode 600), so the key is not the issue. But I am not
submitting this, and I want to say why before anything else.

**Kosmos is not a job you submit.** It is a chat session on a project, and it fans one
objective out into many ordinary tasks over several rounds until it decides it is finished.
That is why JobNames has no member for it: the enum lists the one-shot jobs create_task takes,
and Kosmos sits on the chat surface beside it, under the job name
job-futurehouse-data-analysis-aries.

So there is no single submission to make here, and I am not routing this to ANALYSIS to have
something to run — a different agent answering a different question is the worst outcome
available.

A Kosmos run costs roughly two orders of magnitude more than an API task, so I will not start
one unless you ask for that run in those words. What I can do now, for free:

- draft the research objective with you, since one well-defined objective beats a list of
  questions and is the part that decides what the run is worth;
- check your single-cell data is in a state it can use — processed tables, labelled columns,
  under 5GB;
- read any run you have already started, with get_tasks on its project id.
